resource_details.description: A 34-module progression through classical and modern Machine Learning. Corporate data science interviews heavily index classical algorithms over deep neural networks due to the necessity of model interpretability in corporate environments. This sheet provides the canonical preparation path used by IIT KGP students.
core_theoretical_topics: Tree-Based Methods (Random Forests, Gradient Boosting / XGBoost)
practical_implementation_topics: Python syntax and scientific computing (NumPy, Pandas)
Generative architectures using Flask backends and React frontends
resource_details.key_insight: Corporate interviews heavily index classical ML algorithms (Random Forests, SVM, Linear Models) over deep learning due to interpretability requirements. Students over-indexing on neural networks at the expense of classical ML fundamentals consistently underperform in campus interviews.
recommended_supplementary_literature: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn (Aurélien Géron)
